cs_ttv_sub: How the smallest game there is became a shipped product: published on Google Play in 6 languages, marketed with its own campaign and operated end-to-end.
cs_ttv_f1: languages in production (EN, PT, ES, HI, BN, NE)
cs_ttv_p1: Tic Tac Verse started as a challenge: take tic-tac-toe and treat it like a real product — store listing, real users, ads, analytics and continuous updates, not a tutorial project.
cs_ttv_p2: The flagship mode is Ultimate Tic Tac Toe: 9 boards in one, where every move decides which board the rival must play next. The engine is custom Dart with a 3-level minimax CPU, and the Flutter UI has a neon-arcade identity — pop-in marks, particle win lines and a CPU that visibly 'thinks' before moving.
cs_ttv_p3: Localization followed real data: when campaign reports showed India, Bangladesh and Nepal leading installs, the app gained Hindi, Bengali and Nepali — offered through a polite one-time suggestion, never a forced switch.
cs_ttv_p4: Everything is operated from a Linux server through official APIs: build, upload and staged rollout via the Play Developer API, store listings in 7 languages, AdMob with UMP consent, and Google Ads creatives captured from real gameplay.
cs_wf_sub: A farm-location search engine for Warframe: one search across the official drop tables and the live game state.
cs_wf_f1: pages in the sitemap accepted by Google
cs_wf_f4: front-end frameworks — vanilla JS on purpose
cs_wf_p1: "Where does this drop?" usually means digging through wikis, spreadsheets and outdated forum posts. I wanted a single answer box: type an item, relic or mechanic — get the farming route.
cs_wf_p2: The backend ingests the official drop tables daily (idempotent, transactional), stores them in SQLite and serves fuzzy search with MiniSearch. Live state — Void fissures, Nightwave, Baro — comes from public APIs behind short caches.
cs_wf_p3: Every item, relic and guide gets a clean server-rendered URL with structured data — 4,406 pages accepted by Search Console — and the UI speaks 4 languages while item names stay in English on purpose: that's how the trade community searches.
cs_wf_p4: Before shipping: 107 automated tests, a live adversarial security sweep that found and fixed real issues (like a javascript: URL slipping into server-rendered links) and a multi-viewport frontend review.
